Note: some PR items have "Another Ability (NW)" qualities. These are placeholders for certain and incertain qualities and indicate that the respective item is not yet finished. Some of these placeholders come along with the right figures, for example the Armor Class modifier, so only the name is missing. Others do not even have figures, so we may assume that they stand for nothing. The missing graphics in the PR add to the impression of incompletement. In the PR the "unique picture" quality for unique items is simply missing, so that uniques always use their base item's graphic (effect 2C - this is "homing arrows" in the PR).
So far the tables only contain the Retail uniques which also appear in the PR. As usual, there are two lines per category if the values differ.

*Another Ability = 其他属性
*PRDemo = 发售前版本
*Beta = 测试版本
*Retail = 正式发售版本
*Qlvl = Quality level, 物品的品质等级
属性中数字三行分别依次对应 PR/Beta/Retail
